messages.content: 想像一下，你是一位音樂製作人，正在製作一首新歌。你想要在D調中產生一個每個音符持續2拍的120 BPM音階進行，並考慮使用「小調」音階類型。在創作完這個音階進行後，你決定休息一下，解決一個數學問題。你想要找出456和123這兩個數字的最大公因數。你能夠同時產生音階進行和解決數學問題嗎？

function.name: music_generator_generate_scale_progression
function.description: Generate a music scale progression in a specific key with a given tempo and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

key.description: The key in which to generate the scale progression.

tempo.description: The tempo of the scale progression in BPM.

duration.description: The duration of each note in beats.

scale_type.description: The type of scale to generate. Defaults to 'major'.

function.name: math_hcf
function.description: Calculate the highest common factor of two numbers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
